title: A map, and walking on it
summary: Tutorial chapter one of the mdBook guide: generate a floor with a pass chain, register tiles as ids, spawn a player, and walk via intents through the turn loop.
notes: Classified from content only: no frontmatter and no ADR/PRD/SPEC filename convention; path docs/guide/src is an mdBook tutorial.
